primary.title: Sold a residential property? Here's how you can save tax on capital gains
primary.summary: Long-term capital gains from property sales are eligible for tax exemptions if reinvested in another residential property within specified time frames. Here's how to park your capital gains in the meantime and claim exemption.

related.title: 8th pay commission: Here's how much will the salary hike with 3.83 fitment factor — Check proposed increase
related.summary: The 8th Pay Commission, established in November 2025, is gathering inputs until June 15, 2026. Amid this, some of the proposals put forth to the commission include increase in fitment factor over 3.80 by multiple employee representatives.
